Patient Medical Advice Request – MRN 80227413
From: Pierre-Louis, Wilner   Sent: 11/03/2026 7:42 PM

Hi, I have my infusion Thursday 11/05. My niece Roseline Augustin will drive me. If you need to reach her it is 555-0119. My mouth sores are worse since last cycle, is that normal?

From: Infusion RN Pool   Sent: 11/04/2026 8:10 AM

Mr. Pierre-Louis, mouth sores (mucositis) can happen with 5-FU. Use a salt and baking soda rinse 4x daily and avoid alcohol mouthwash. We will assess on Thursday before your infusion.
